How it works

Start buildingMessage fast

Use the world’s fastest in-memory database’s stream data structure and pub/sub messaging framework to send messages between services in real-time. Together, they keep your modern architecture delivering modern performance.

Explore pub/subReduce complexity

We bring it all together with streams, pub/sub support, and flexible data models for async communication, message queuing, and prioritization. You also get fast tools like caching and session management for making your microservices apps faster.

PersistenceMessage with confidence

Get reliable service communication and know your messages are safe with our durable and resilient design. Robust persistence options mean no messages are lost, even during system failures.

The key features

Persistence

We offer persistence options to ensure messages aren’t lost and can be recovered in event of failure. We also provide point-in-time Redis snapshots (RDB) as well as more advanced persistence options, like append-only-file (AOF) persistence that logs every write and persists it to disk.

Pub/Sub

Broadcast live notifications with pub/sub for instant, efficient and lightweight messaging, perfect for low-latency, high-throughput service interactions.

Redis streams

Build streaming architectures and persist data effectively with Redis streams, the ideal structure for real-time communication and event sourcing.

Read about Redis streams
Redis lists and sorted sets

Create simple and efficient message queues using lists for straightforward messaging, and sorted sets for priority queues based on timestamps or scores.
